title: PR316 staging-local enum-domain alignment before historical writers

phases.objective: Align historical MariaDB enum domains before migration 199 and migration 316 writers while preserving the local Staging-only boundary.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Evaluate the exact PR head against the ordered migration, enum, text-width, environment, and governance contracts.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The ordered enum guard blocks direct and CASE literals in INSERT...SELECT when undeclared, the two additive bridges align historical writer domains, and no local Staging replay proceeds until a fresh exact-main preflight and approved replay.
steps: Classify the exact base-to-head changes against the canonical environment path classes.
Verify repo_certification_runs.certification_type includes the path_scope writer domain before migration 199.
Verify workspace_resource_grants.source includes the workspace_registry_membership_backfill writer domain before migration 316.
Verify both additive bridges preserve existing enum values, defaults, charset/collation, indexes, and rows without data DML.
Verify ordered enum and text-width guards report zero findings and zero database/provider/credential/runtime mutations.
Bind all evidence to the exact evaluated HEAD SHA before any future Windows-local replay is considered.
assertions: The environment impact declaration source of truth is the canonical deployment branch policy.
Both staging and production are explicitly declared and cross-environment review is true.
Live staging certification remains required and is not silently waived.
No migration DML, database mutation, provider mutation, credential payload read, deployment, AutoPilot, importer, or readback is introduced.
